nodes.label: rev2-admin master compose (base layer)
nodes.rationale: Base layer deliberately omits host ports and dev/prod-specific volumes so dev/prod override files can list-append without conflict; base-web omits image/build/command because dev (node:20) and prod (nginx multi-stage) are heterogeneous and cannot be unified via build.target, while rust-api keeps build because dev/prod share one Dockerfile differing only by target.

nodes.label: front-nginx service
nodes.rationale: Reverse-proxy edge; healthcheck uses 127.0.0.1 (not localhost) because alpine /etc/hosts resolves localhost to ::1 (IPv6) but nginx listens on IPv4:80, so localhost would connection-refuse and the healthcheck would never pass.

nodes.label: base-web service
nodes.rationale: image/build/command intentionally left out of base layer: dev override is node:20.19-alpine (no build), prod override is nginx multi-stage build; placing build in base would mis-tag it as node:20.

nodes.label: rust-api service
nodes.rationale: Builds from deploy/Dockerfile.rust-api.txt target=runtime; reads JWT/db/redis secrets via *_FILE env convention; depends on postgres, redis-stack, and migrate completing successfully (server does not auto-migrate, 007 FR-009).

nodes.label: migrate one-shot service
nodes.rationale: Dedicated one-shot migration service so the server binary never auto-migrates (007 FR-009); dev/prod overrides supply target+command, base defines only the shared structure.

nodes.label: cleanup-job on-demand service
nodes.rationale: 030 on-demand maintenance job purging expired sys_token; profile:[jobs] so plain `up` does not start it (FR-007); host cron or manual trigger; dry-run by default, --execute to actually delete; mirrors migrate one-shot structure; uses dedicated cleanup_database_url secret (least-priv role).

nodes.label: postgres service
nodes.rationale: postgres:17-alpine, user soybean, db soybean_admin_rust, password via POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE secret; named volume postgres_data.

nodes.label: redis-stack service
nodes.rationale: redis/redis-stack-server; password supplied via $(cat /run/secrets/redis_password) literal shell expansion rather than ${VAR} interpolation; volume redis_stack_data.

nodes.label: acme service (prod profile)
nodes.rationale: acme.sh skeleton gated behind profile:[prod]; shares front_nginx_certs volume; real cert acquisition deferred (needs public domain + DNS provider).

nodes.label: loki log store (obs profile)
nodes.rationale: 031 obs-min log storage / LogQL; profile:[obs] opt-in; volume loki_data.

nodes.label: alloy log collector (obs profile)
nodes.rationale: 031 obs-min log collection replacing EOL promtail; runs as root to read the docker socket (root:docker mode 660) for portable container-stdout discovery; non-root hardening deferred to security pass (research R11).

nodes.label: prometheus (metrics profile)
nodes.rationale: 032 obs-full metrics scrape+store, profile:[metrics], 15d TSDB retention; volume prometheus_data.

nodes.label: postgres_exporter (metrics profile)
nodes.rationale: 032 metrics exporter reusing the postgres_password secret via DATA_SOURCE_PASS_FILE; no host port, scraped by prometheus.

nodes.label: redis_exporter (metrics profile)
nodes.rationale: Uses oliver006/redis_exporter -alpine variant because the default FROM-scratch image has no /bin/sh and the sh-wrapper entrypoint would crash; sh-wrapper reads the raw secret file and exports REDIS_PASSWORD (the native REDIS_PASSWORD_FILE expects a JSON map, upstream #613) then exec's the exporter.

nodes.label: pushgateway (metrics profile)
nodes.rationale: 032 short-lived job metrics push target (cleanup-job pushes); in-memory, no persistent volume, forgets on restart.

nodes.label: grafana service (obs+metrics profiles)
nodes.rationale: Shared log+metrics UI across both obs and metrics profiles; uses long-form depends_on with required:false on loki so a metrics-only startup (loki absent from active set) still launches.

nodes.label: base-web oxlint config
nodes.rationale: correctness+suspicious categories as errors; plugins eslint/typescript/unicorn/oxc/import/vue; oxlint+eslint are the fast lint pass invoked by the lint script and pre-commit hook.

nodes.label: base-web oxfmt config
nodes.rationale: printWidth 120, single quotes, no trailing comma, avoid arrow parens; ignores generated typings (components.d.ts, elegant-router.d.ts) and the elegant router dir.

nodes.label: base-web eslint config

nodes.label: base-web tsconfig.json
nodes.rationale: moduleResolution bundler, strict + strictNullChecks, isolatedModules; path aliases @/* -> ./src/* and ~/* -> ./* mirroring vite aliases.

nodes.label: base-web uno.config.ts

nodes.label: base-web pnpm-workspace.yaml

nodes.label: flexible permission routing (static + dynamic)

nodes.label: *_FILE docker secrets convention

nodes.label: profile-gated observability stack

nodes.label: createAlovaRequest
nodes.rationale: Factory that builds a configured alova request instance with server token authentication (refresh-on-success / refresh-on-error), backend-success detection, response transform and error hooks. Chosen over a plain instance so the framework can centralize token refresh and backend error-code mapping.

nodes.label: BACKEND_ERROR_CODE (alova)
nodes.rationale: Sentinel error code 'BACKEND_ERROR' used to tag synthetic errors raised when the backend reports a logical (non-HTTP) failure.

nodes.label: RequestOptions (alova)
nodes.rationale: Defines the contract for backend-success check, token refresher, transformBackendResponse and error hooks consumed by createAlovaRequest.

nodes.label: createCommonRequest (axios)
nodes.rationale: Builds the shared axios instance with request-id injection, abort-controller map, retry, and request/response interceptors that drive backend-success detection and error handling.

nodes.label: createFlatRequest (axios)
nodes.rationale: Returns a flat { data, error, response } shape instead of throwing, so call sites can destructure errors without try/catch. This flat shape is the dominant pattern used by base-web service/api modules.

nodes.label: BACKEND_ERROR_CODE / REQUEST_ID_KEY (axios)
nodes.rationale: REQUEST_ID_KEY='X-Request-Id' header injected per request (correlates with rust-api / nginx request-id logging); BACKEND_ERROR_CODE mirrors the alova package constant.

nodes.label: createDefaultOptions (axios)
nodes.rationale: Supplies default RequestOption hooks; isBackendSuccess defaults to true and transform falls back to deprecated transformBackendResponse for back-compat.

nodes.label: isHttpSuccess (axios)
nodes.rationale: Treats 2xx and 304 as success; wired as axios validateStatus so non-2xx falls through to the error path.

nodes.label: RequestOption (axios)
nodes.rationale: Defines transform / isBackendSuccess / onBackendFail / onError hooks; onBackendFail is the seam used to handle expired-token refresh.

nodes.label: FlatResponseData
nodes.rationale: Discriminated union of success ({data,error:null,response}) and fail ({data:null,error,response}) returned by createFlatRequest.

nodes.label: colorNames
nodes.rationale: Static lookup table of ~1500 [hex, name] tuples; reference dataset used by nearest-color name matching.

nodes.label: colorPalettes
nodes.rationale: Tailwind-style color palette families (Slate..Rose), each with 50..950 swatches; reference dataset for recommended-palette nearest-match.

nodes.label: getAntDPaletteColorByIndex
nodes.rationale: Ant Design palette generation algorithm: derives a swatch at a given index (6 = main) by stepping hue/saturation/value in HSV space.

nodes.label: getAntDColorPalette
nodes.rationale: Produces the full 11-swatch AntD palette; dark theme variant mixes against a base dark color via a fixed index/opacity map.

nodes.label: getRecommendedColorPaletteFamily
nodes.rationale: Picks the nearest palette family by deltaE then re-derives all swatches by shifting hue/saturation relative to the matched palette's lightness anchor.

nodes.label: getDeltaE
nodes.rationale: Perceptual color distance (CIE delta-E via colord lab plugin); drives nearest-palette selection.

nodes.label: getColorName
nodes.rationale: Finds the closest human-readable color name by minimizing a weighted RGB + HSL squared-distance over the colorNames table.

nodes.label: ColorPaletteNumber
nodes.rationale: Type union 50|100|..|950; the swatch-number contract shared across palette/recommend.

nodes.label: ColorIndex
nodes.rationale: Type union 1..11 indexing AntD palette swatches, main color = 6.

nodes.label: useCountDown
nodes.rationale: rAF-based countdown decoupled from screen refresh rate; accumulates elapsed delta rather than fixed-tick decrement.

nodes.label: useContext
nodes.rationale: Typed provide/inject pair factory; consumer with a name throws if used outside its provider, giving React-like context ergonomics in Vue.

nodes.label: useSvgIconRender
nodes.rationale: Returns a VNode factory wrapping a SvgIcon component, supporting iconify icon name or local icon + color/size styling.

nodes.label: createHookRequest
nodes.rationale: Wraps @sa/axios createFlatRequest into a reactive (loading/data/error refs) hook-style request instance.

nodes.label: useTable
nodes.rationale: Generic table data orchestrator: calls a supplied api fn, transforms response, manages loading/empty/columnChecks; pagination-aware.

nodes.label: TableColumnCheck
nodes.rationale: Per-column visibility/checked/fixed descriptor used to drive column toggling UI.

nodes.label: createLayoutCssVars
nodes.rationale: Derives z-index layering for header/tab/sider/footer from a single maxZIndex prop so the layout stack ordering stays internally consistent without per-element manual z-index tuning.

nodes.label: createLayoutCssVarsByCssVarsProps
nodes.rationale: Maps a resolved props object to --soy-* CSS custom properties; isolates the literal CSS-var-name string mapping from the z-index computation logic.

nodes.label: AdminLayout component (index.vue)
nodes.rationale: Slot-driven layout shell; element visibility is gated on both a *Visible prop AND presence of the corresponding slot, so an unused region collapses automatically.

nodes.label: PageTab component (index.vue)
nodes.rationale: Strategy/dispatcher component: a mode->component map (chrome/button/slider) picks the concrete tab renderer at runtime via :is, keeping a single public PageTab API over three visual variants.

nodes.label: createTabCssVars
nodes.rationale: Expands a single activeColor into a family of opacity/tinted --soy-primary-* CSS vars via @sa/color helpers, so tab variants share one color source of truth.

nodes.label: SimpleScrollbar component
nodes.rationale: Thin wrapper over simplebar-vue exposing a default slot; centralizes the simplebar CSS import so consumers get styled scrollbars without importing CSS themselves.

nodes.label: LayoutCssVars (mapped --soy- keys)
nodes.rationale: Uses a KebabCase template-literal mapped type to derive the exact --soy-* CSS var key names from prop names at the type level, so runtime var names and types cannot drift.

nodes.label: setupCli (soybean-admin sa CLI)
nodes.rationale: cac-based command registry exposing cleanup/update-pkg/git-commit/changelog/release/gen-route; single entry that wires CLI flags to command actions loaded from config.

nodes.label: locales
nodes.rationale: zh-cn/en-us message catalog for the git-commit CLI: commit type list, scope list, prompt strings, and the Conventional Commits verify error.

nodes.label: Crypto
nodes.rationale: Generic AES (crypto-js) encrypt/decrypt helper class; JSON-serializes data with a secret; decrypt swallows parse errors and returns null.

nodes.label: createStorage
nodes.rationale: Typed synchronous local/sessionStorage wrapper with key prefixing and JSON (de)serialization; removes corrupt entries on parse failure.

nodes.label: createLocalforage
nodes.rationale: Typed async storage wrapper over localforage (IndexedDB/WebSQL/localStorage drivers).

nodes.label: jsonClone
nodes.rationale: Re-export of klona/json deep-clone.

nodes.label: Soybean Admin logo (favicon)
nodes.rationale: Stylized soybean-sprout/leaf mark formed from layered blue/indigo gradient paths (#373ebf to #c2d6ff palette); brand favicon for the admin SPA.

nodes.label: health probe target
nodes.rationale: Static `ok` body served outside SPA rendering; nginx try_files hits it directly, bypassing SPA fallback. Added by feature 002-dockerfile-base-web as an ops health probe.

nodes.label: App.vue
nodes.rationale: Root Vue SFC. Wraps app in NConfigProvider (naive-ui theme/locale/dark) + AppProvider + RouterView + NWatermark. Reads useAppStore (locale) and useThemeStore (darkMode, naiveTheme, watermark). Watermark is fullscreen cross-tiled, zIndex 9999.

nodes.label: setupApp
nodes.rationale: Async bootstrap entry. Ordered setup: loading -> nprogress -> iconify offline -> dayjs -> createApp(App) -> store -> router(await) -> pro naive components -> i18n -> app version notification -> vue root transition validator -> mount('#app'). Router setup is the only awaited step (route guard / dynamic route load).

nodes.label: useThemeStore (consumed by App)
nodes.rationale: App.vue binds themeStore.darkMode -> darkTheme, themeStore.naiveTheme -> theme-overrides, themeStore.watermark/watermarkContent -> NWatermark.

nodes.label: useAppStore (consumed by App)
nodes.rationale: App.vue binds appStore.locale -> naive UI locale + date-locale lookup tables.

nodes.label: activity icon
nodes.rationale: Feather-style line icon: an ECG/heartbeat pulse line (zig-zag spike across a baseline). currentColor stroke, 24x24, used to denote activity/monitoring/vitals.

nodes.label: alova logo
nodes.rationale: Brand logo for the Alova HTTP request library: blue/teal gradient stylised double-arrow / lightning-bolt-like glyph (two mirrored chevron shapes). Represents the request strategy library used (or referenced) by the frontend.

nodes.label: at-sign icon
nodes.rationale: Feather feather-at-sign icon: '@' symbol (circle with surrounding arc). Denotes email / mention / account handle.

nodes.label: avatar icon
nodes.rationale: Detailed illustrated user avatar: a person's head/face with hair, beard stubble, neck and collar, drawn in flat tones (skin #f9d2b5, hair #554c44). Default profile picture placeholder.

nodes.label: banner illustration
nodes.rationale: Large decorative scene illustration (500x500): two framed pictures/screens on a wall, a potted-plant/ladder shelf, and a seated couple figure. Used as a login/landing hero banner. Uses currentColor for theme accent.

nodes.label: cast icon
nodes.rationale: Feather feather-cast icon: a screen/monitor rectangle with broadcast/wifi arcs emanating from a corner. Denotes screen-cast / streaming / broadcast.

nodes.label: chrome icon
nodes.rationale: Feather chrome icon: outer circle, inner circle (hub), and three spokes - the Google Chrome browser glyph. Denotes browser / web.

nodes.label: copy icon
nodes.rationale: Feather copy icon: two overlapping rounded rectangles (a sheet on top of another). Denotes copy-to-clipboard / duplicate action.

nodes.label: custom-icon (visual feedback)
nodes.rationale: A filled circular face/emoji-like glyph (smile arc inside a circle, currentColor). Material-design style 'mood' / feedback / custom-icon placeholder demonstrating registering a local SVG as an iconify icon.

nodes.label: empty-data illustration
nodes.rationale: Empty-state illustration (500x500): a person figure beside a tall stack of document/data sheets with a plant, conveying 'no data / empty list'. Shown when a table or list returns zero rows. Uses currentColor accent.

nodes.label: expectation illustration
nodes.rationale: Freepik-sourced scene illustration (500x500): a couple/figures with furniture, framed wall art and plants. Decorative 'coming soon / expectation' or about-page hero graphic.

nodes.label: heart icon
nodes.rationale: Feather heart icon: classic heart outline (two arcs meeting at a point). Denotes favourite / like / love.

nodes.label: soybean logo
nodes.rationale: The Soybean Admin brand logo: stylised intertwined ribbon/knot 'S' mark rendered in currentColor (160x160), so it inherits theme primary color. Primary app branding shown in sidebar header / login.

nodes.label: network-error illustration
nodes.rationale: Error-state illustration (500x500): a smartphone/device with a broken-WiFi or disconnection motif and a server/grid in background. Shown for HTTP network failures / offline (matches a network/connection error response).

nodes.label: no-icon placeholder
nodes.rationale: A filled circle with a diagonal slash through it (200x200, currentColor) - the 'no icon selected' / icon-missing placeholder used in menu icon picker when a menu has no icon.

nodes.label: no-permission (403) illustration
nodes.rationale: 403 forbidden illustration (500x500): figures/scene with a large isometric crate/structure and barrier motif. Shown on the 403 'no permission' page when route/menu access is denied (Casbin enforce fail).

nodes.label: not-found (404) illustration
nodes.rationale: 404 illustration (500x500): figures around stacked/scattered objects (boxes, a large block-3D structure). Shown on the 404 not-found route page.

nodes.label: service-error (500) illustration
nodes.rationale: 500 server-error illustration (500x500): figures/scene with crates and a large structure, isometric. Shown on the 500 'service error' page when the backend returns a server error.

nodes.label: VisActor logo
nodes.rationale: Brand logo for VisActor (VChart/VTable visualization library): pink/magenta gradient bird-like / origami mark (clip-path masked). Used to denote the charting library option in the admin.

nodes.label: wind icon
nodes.rationale: Feather feather-wind icon: three horizontal lines each ending in a small loop, depicting wind gusts. Often used to denote UnoCSS/Tailwind 'wind' / atomic-css or weather.

nodes.label: HTTP error-state illustrations
nodes.rationale: Family of full-scene SVGs (network-error, no-permission/403, not-found/404, service-error/500) each mapped to an HTTP-failure UI page. They are the visual counterparts of backend error responses / route guards.

nodes.label: Feather-style line icon set
nodes.rationale: Uniform 24x24, fill=none, stroke=currentColor, stroke-width 3, round caps icons (activity, at-sign, cast, chrome, copy, heart, wind). Theme-inheriting via currentColor; registered as local iconify offline icons (see setupIconifyOffline).

nodes.label: TableColumnSetting
nodes.rationale: Popover-based column visibility/order/fixed editor over NaiveUI.TableColumnCheck[] via v-model; drag-reorder + select-all + per-column fixed toggle cycling left/right/unFixed

nodes.label: TableHeaderOperation
nodes.rationale: CRUD table toolbar emitting add/delete/refresh; embeds TableColumnSetting and proxies its columns v-model

nodes.label: AppProvider
nodes.rationale: Wraps app in naive-ui Loading/Dialog/Notification/Message providers and registers window.$dialog/$message/$notification/$loadingBar globals via ContextHolder

nodes.label: DarkModeContainer
nodes.rationale: Theming container applying bg-container/bg-inverted classes for dark-mode-aware backgrounds

nodes.label: ExceptionBase
nodes.rationale: 403/404/500 error page rendering a local SvgIcon per type and a back-to-home button via routerPushByKey('root')

nodes.label: FullScreen
nodes.rationale: Toggle button showing fullscreen/exit icon based on full prop

nodes.label: IconTooltip
nodes.rationale: NTooltip wrapping a SvgIcon trigger with desc text; throws if neither icon/localIcon nor custom trigger slot given

nodes.label: LangSwitch
nodes.rationale: NDropdown of App.I18n.LangOption[] emitting changeLang(App.I18n.LangType)

nodes.label: MenuToggler
nodes.rationale: Sidebar collapse/expand button selecting icon from collapsed x arrowIcon matrix

nodes.label: PinToggler
nodes.rationale: Pin/unpin toggle button rendering mdi-pin / mdi-pin-off based on pin prop

nodes.label: ReloadButton
nodes.rationale: Reload button with spinning icon while loading

nodes.label: SystemLogo
nodes.rationale: Inline SVG soybean app logo; 7 gradient-filled paths driven by CSS vars --logo-color-300..700 mapped to --primary-N00-color so logo recolors with theme primary palette

nodes.label: ThemeSchemaSwitch
nodes.rationale: Cycles light/dark/auto theme scheme; emits switch and shows scheme-specific icon via UnionKey.ThemeScheme

nodes.label: BetterScroll
nodes.rationale: Wraps @better-scroll/core BScroll, refreshing on content/wrapper size change via useElementSize watch

nodes.label: ButtonIcon

nodes.rationale: rev2 權威名 Super/Admin/User，對齊 base-web mock ground truth；3 user 共用 runtime 生成 argon2id hash。

nodes.label: sys_operation_log table
nodes.rationale: Append-only operation audit table: operation, entity_table, entity_id, payload_before/after (jsonb), operator_id, operator_ip (INET), trace_id, created_at. CRUD/state-change audit log.

nodes.label: casbin_rule table
nodes.rationale: Casbin RBAC policy table. DDL is NOT hand-written here; delegated entirely to sea_orm_adapter::up/down to keep single schema source and avoid drift with the adapter's load/store. Stock schema: ptype + v0..v5 all NOT NULL no default.

nodes.label: sys_role table
nodes.rationale: Roles table: id BIGSERIAL, code, name, deleted_at. Partial unique index sys_role_code_active_uniq on code WHERE deleted_at IS NULL (soft-delete-aware uniqueness). Seeds 3 roles R_SUPER/R_ADMIN/R_USER_COMMON idempotently.

nodes.label: sys_user_role join table
nodes.rationale: User-role join table with composite PK (user_id, role_id). Seeds 1->R_SUPER, 2->R_ADMIN, 3->R_USER_COMMON; role_id resolved via code subquery (not hard-coded id) for robustness.

nodes.label: sys_user add nick_name
nodes.rationale: Adds nullable nick_name to sys_user; seeds nick_name Super/Admin for id 1/2, but id 3 (user_name 'User') gets alias 'User01'.

nodes.label: seed casbin getUserList endpoint policy
nodes.rationale: Casbin p = sub,obj,act -> v0=role code, v1=path, v2=HTTP method. Seeds /systemManage/getUserList GET for R_SUPER + R_ADMIN only; R_USER_COMMON deliberately omitted (deny case). v3/v4/v5 filled with empty strings to match stock adapter empty-column representation.

nodes.label: seed menu-visibility casbin policy
nodes.rationale: Menu-visibility policy (D3 route-visibility matrix): v2='menu' domain distinct from v2=HTTP-method endpoint domain, sharing casbin_rule table. Three tiers: home->all 3 roles; manage_user/manage_user-detail->R_SUPER+R_ADMIN; manage_role/manage_menu->R_SUPER. Parent 'manage' not seeded (visibility via tree-prune).

nodes.label: sys_access_log table
nodes.rationale: Append-only authenticated-request audit table: operator_id, method, path, http_status, client_ip (INET), x_forwarded_for, region, trace_id, created_at. No updated/deleted columns.

nodes.label: sys_login_attempt table
nodes.rationale: Append-only login-attempt audit table: attempted_user_name, success, operator_id, client_ip (INET), x_forwarded_for, region, trace_id, created_at. Indexes idx_login_attempt_user_time and idx_login_attempt_ip_time for rate/brute-force queries.

nodes.label: seed getRoleList/getAllRoles casbin policy
nodes.rationale: Mirrors 009 pattern. getRoleList GET = SUPER+ADMIN (role list is management-page data); getAllRoles GET = SUPER+ADMIN+USER_COMMON (role-picker full set needed by ordinary users). getUserList deliberately owned by 009.

nodes.label: sys_user add business + audit columns
nodes.rationale: Adds user_gender/user_phone/user_email/status + 9 audit columns (created_at/by, updated_at/by, deleted_by). Highest-risk: retrofits id BIGSERIAL (sys_user_id_seq OWNED BY id, setval is_called to avoid seed 1/2/3) because migration 001 had no sequence and addUser does not supply id. Backfills status=1 for seed rows.

nodes.label: seed user write-endpoint casbin policy
nodes.rationale: Mirrors 009/013. User write endpoints all R_SUPER only (no wildcard): addUser/updateUser POST, deleteUser/batchDeleteUser DELETE. Non-Super write -> enforce_mw 403.

nodes.label: sys_role add business + audit columns
nodes.rationale: Adds role_desc/status + 7 audit columns (created_at/by, updated_at/by, deleted_by). No id BIGSERIAL retrofit needed (sys_role.id already BIGSERIAL since migration 006). Backfills status=1 for seed roles id 1/2/3.

nodes.label: seed role write-endpoint casbin policy
nodes.rationale: Mirrors 015/009/013. Role write endpoints all R_SUPER only: addRole/updateRole POST, deleteRole/batchDeleteRole DELETE.

nodes.label: sys_menu table
nodes.rationale: First business table built after audit-column freeze: includes 6 audit columns up front (forward-only, no retrofit). Columns mirror base-web route schema: route_name, menu_type, route_path, component, icon, i18n_key, order (SQL reserved word -> double-quoted), buttons (jsonb), etc. Partial unique index on route_name WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. Seeds home + manage tree + 4 children, verbatim reproducing server/src/route/menu.rs business_routes() (D5 regression rule).

nodes.label: seed menu-list read-endpoint casbin policy
nodes.rationale: Mirrors 017. Menu read endpoints R_SUPER only (clarify Q1): getMenuList/v2, getAllPages, getMenuTree all GET. Down deletes only these 3 by v1, not touching 010 v2='menu' policy.

nodes.label: seed menu write-endpoint casbin policy
nodes.rationale: Mirrors 017/019. Menu write endpoints R_SUPER only: addMenu/updateMenu POST, deleteMenu/batchDeleteMenu DELETE.

nodes.label: sys_role add home + menu-auth casbin policy
nodes.rationale: (1) ALTER sys_role +home (per-role home route name; backfill all roles home='home' for per-role getUserRoutes default). (2) menu-auth 4 endpoints R_SUPER only: getRoleMenu/getRoleHome GET, updateRoleMenu/updateRoleHome POST.
nodes.norm_label: sys_role add home + menu-auth casbin policy

nodes.label: seed button-auth (sys_menu + casbin button/menu/endpoint)
nodes.rationale: (1) INSERT function + function_toggle-auth into sys_menu (verbatim from base-web routes.ts, revives toggle-auth demo). (2) UPDATE manage_user.buttons (user:add/edit/delete registry). (3) Casbin BUTTON policy v2='button': 10 rows role x code (getUserInfo.buttons aggregates from these). (4) MENU policy v2='menu' for function/function_toggle-auth x 3 roles (6 rows). (5) ENDPOINT policy: getAllButtons/getRoleButton/updateRoleButton R_SUPER only.

nodes.label: seed endpoint-governance casbin policy
nodes.rationale: ENDPOINT-governance self-management endpoints R_SUPER only: getAllEndpoints/getRoleEndpoints GET, updateRoleEndpoints POST. Lets Super runtime-edit the role x endpoint matrix via modal. Purely additive (no Admin/User seed, no table).

nodes.label: seed role/menu manage-page button-auth
nodes.rationale: ButtonAuth rollout: (a) UPDATE manage_role/manage_menu.buttons (role:* / menu:* registries, mirrors 022). (b) Casbin BUTTON policy R_SUPER 6 new codes initial grant. Backend zero-change: getAllButtons aggregates all active sys_menu.buttons -> new codes auto-register; set_role_button HARD REPLACE code-agnostic.

nodes.label: seed menu-restore casbin policy
nodes.rationale: Menu-restore (recycle bin) endpoints R_SUPER only: getDeletedMenus GET, restoreMenu POST. Lets Super list soft-deleted menus and restore them. Purely additive.

nodes.label: Casbin RBAC model (p=sub,obj,act)
nodes.rationale: Shared policy model across all seed migrations. v0=role code (sub), v1=object (path / route_name / button code), v2=act/domain (HTTP method 'GET'/'POST'/'DELETE', or 'menu', or 'button'). Single casbin_rule table multiplexes three policy domains by v2.

nodes.label: Casbin v2='menu' visibility domain
nodes.rationale: Menu/route visibility policy domain. v1=route_name, v2='menu'. Determines which roles see which menu routes; consumed by getUserRoutes tree-prune. Seeded across 010 (core routes) and 022 (function routes).

nodes.label: Casbin v2='button' permission domain
nodes.rationale: Per-role button permission domain. v1=button code, v2='button'. getUserInfo.buttons aggregates grants from this domain. 022 introduces user:*/B_CODE* codes, 024 adds role:*/menu:* codes.

nodes.label: enforce_mw endpoint authorization middleware
nodes.rationale: Runtime middleware that enforces (role, path, method) against casbin_rule endpoint domain. Missing policy row -> 403 / error code 5003 even for Super. All endpoint-policy seed migrations (009/013/015/017/019/020/021/022/023/025) feed this middleware's policy set.

nodes.label: soft-delete-aware partial unique index pattern
nodes.rationale: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ... WHERE deleted_at IS NULL enforces uniqueness only among active rows, allowing soft-deleted rows to retain their code/route_name. Applied to sys_role.code, sys_menu.route_name, sys_user.user_name. WHY: soft-delete must not collide with re-creating an entity using the same natural key.

nodes.label: /systemManage/* wire endpoint namespace
nodes.rationale: The /systemManage/* paths in casbin policy v1 are the wire contract between base-web service/api calls and rust-api handlers/routes. Policy path has no /api prefix (front-nginx strips it). Endpoints span user/role/menu/button/endpoint/restore management.

nodes.label: m027 alter_sys_user_session Migration
nodes.rationale: 028 single-session: adds current_session_id (uuid str, NULL=none/off) + session_policy (per-account, default 'inherit') columns to sys_user; system default decides on/off

nodes.label: m028 create_system_settings Migration
nodes.rationale: Generic system-settings KV foundation table (PK=setting_key VARCHAR, not auto-id) with the 6 audit cols; forward-only. Seeds single_session_default='off' row

nodes.label: m029 seed_settings_admin Migration
nodes.rationale: 029 admin UI seed (additive 3-part): casbin endpoint policy (R_SUPER only) for getSystemSettings/updateSystemSetting/updateUserSessionPolicy, new sys_menu manage_system-settings page, casbin menu policy

nodes.label: m031 alter_casbin_rule_governance Migration
nodes.rationale: 034 governance: adds 3 adapter-invisible cols to casbin_rule (protected data-driven, created_at, created_by). Stock adapter insert_many doesn't fill them so NOT NULL+default; load_policy uses column-explicit entity that doesn't SELECT them, so no fork adapter needed

nodes.label: m032 create_casbin_policy_archive Migration
nodes.rationale: 034 archive table sys_casbin_policy_archive: restore buffer holding only revoked-not-restored rows (restore = physical delete). Append-only variant of audit cols (no updated_*/deleted_*), logical-only no DB FK. Indexes archived_at and (v0,v2)

nodes.label: m033 seed_protected_policy Migration
nodes.rationale: 034 US2: marks 16 existing governance casbin_rule rows protected=true (3 menu-visibility for manage_menu/manage_role/manage_system-settings + 13 R_SUPER endpoint rows: 7 GET + 6 POST). D13 patch extended self-lock-out protection beyond just manage_menu

nodes.label: m034 alter_sys_menu_protected Migration
nodes.rationale: 034 US2: adds data-driven sys_menu.protected bool col + seeds 7 protected menus (home/manage/manage_user/manage_role/manage_menu/manage_user-detail + manage_system-settings)

nodes.label: m035 seed_policy_archive_page Migration
nodes.rationale: 035 US5 policy recycle-bin page seed (mirrors m029 3-part + protected): casbin endpoint policy for getArchivedPolicies/restorePolicy (R_SUPER only), new sys_menu manage_policy-archive page, casbin menu policy; all 3 new casbin rows + new menu row marked protected=true to prevent Super self-lock-out

nodes.label: migration CLI main (Migrator)
nodes.rationale: migration binary entry: resolves DATABASE_URL from APP_DATABASE_URL_FILE > APP_DATABASE_URL, runs sea_orm_migration cli::run_cli(Migrator)

nodes.label: action::remove_policy
nodes.rationale: deletes one casbin_rule by ptype + all 6 v-columns, returns rows_affected==1

nodes.label: action::remove_filtered_policy
nodes.rationale: rev2 correctness fix (012 plan Deviation D-1): rule.values fills from v0 so only COLUMNS gets [index_of_match_start..] offset; do NOT also slice rule.values (rev1 bug causes double-offset misalignment)

nodes.label: action::load_policy
nodes.rationale: Entity::find().all() loads all casbin_rule rows as entity::Model. Column-explicit SeaORM entity does not SELECT the 034 governance cols (protected/created_at/created_by) so adapter stays unaware of them

nodes.label: action::load_filtered_policy
nodes.rationale: builds OR condition from g-filter and p-filter, returns matching entity::Model rows

nodes.label: action::save_policies
nodes.rationale: clear_policy then add_policies (full overwrite)

nodes.label: action::add_policy
nodes.rationale: create_active_model then insert one casbin_rule row

nodes.label: action::add_policies
nodes.rationale: Entity::insert_many of mapped active models

nodes.label: action::create_active_model
nodes.rationale: builds entity::ActiveModel with id NotSet + ptype + v0..v5; does NOT set 034 governance cols (they fall to NOT NULL+default)

nodes.label: action::clear_policy
nodes.rationale: Entity::delete_many() wipes all casbin_rule rows

nodes.label: SeaOrmAdapter
nodes.rationale: casbin Adapter impl over a SeaORM ConnectionTrait; SeaOrmAdapter::new calls migration::up (if_not_exists, harmless no-op since migration 005 already created the table)

nodes.label: SeaOrmAdapter::load_policy
nodes.rationale: casbin trait method: action::load_policy then insert each normalized policy into the in-memory casbin Model

nodes.label: SeaOrmAdapter::save_policy
nodes.rationale: collects p and g rules from casbin model, action::save_policies

nodes.label: SeaOrmAdapter::normalize_policy
nodes.rationale: trims trailing empty v-columns from an entity::Model into a Vec<String> policy line

nodes.label: casbin_rule entity::Model
nodes.rationale: SeaORM Model for casbin_rule: id + ptype + v0..v5 ONLY (column-explicit). Intentionally omits the 034 governance cols protected/created_at/created_by so the stock adapter never reads/writes them

nodes.label: sea-orm-adapter lib (re-exports)
nodes.rationale: crate root re-exporting SeaOrmAdapter + migration up/down; entity module public

nodes.label: adapter migration::up
nodes.rationale: if_not_exists CREATE TABLE casbin_rule (id + ptype + v0..v5) + unique index on (ptype,v0..v5). Called by SeaOrmAdapter::new; harmless no-op when the real migration already created the table

nodes.label: adapter migration::down
nodes.rationale: if_exists DROP TABLE casbin_rule

nodes.label: RequestContext
nodes.rationale: per-request audit context (client_ip/x_forwarded_for/region/trace_id/operator_id) inserted into request extensions; downstream handlers (login US2, access-log US1) read it back out

nodes.label: audit_ctx::ctx_mw
nodes.rationale: global outermost request-context middleware; captures peer IP + XFF + region + trace_id + operator (verify_bearer), runs next, then best-effort writes one sys_access_log row gated on operator_id.is_some() (implements FR-001 logged + FR-002 not-logged with no path exclusion list)

nodes.label: audit_ctx::resolve_region
nodes.rationale: best-effort xdb geo lookup; IPv4 only (xdb ToUIntIP), IPv6 yields None, never panics per-request

nodes.label: audit_ctx::extract_xff
nodes.rationale: extracts raw X-Forwarded-For header verbatim

nodes.label: audit_ctx::extract_trace_id
nodes.rationale: honors caller X-Request-Id else mints a UUID v4

nodes.label: AppConfig
nodes.rationale: runtime merged config (yaml + secrets from env/_FILE); AppConfig::load reads application.yaml from CWD and loads jwt/db/redis secrets

nodes.label: config::load_secret
nodes.rationale: secret loader with <KEY>_FILE > <KEY> envvar precedence, then validate_secret

nodes.label: config::validate_secret
nodes.rationale: rejects empty, case-insensitive placeholder (change-me/secret/etc), or length < 32

nodes.label: config::parse_session_default
nodes.rationale: 028 FR-007 dormant-on-launch: case-insensitive 'on' from APP_JWT_SESSION_DEFAULT -> SessionMode::On, everything else -> Off; never errors

nodes.label: config::SessionMode
nodes.rationale: 028 enum On/Off; On revokes prior sessions on new login, Off preserves 027 stateless multi-device

nodes.label: envelope::Res<T>
nodes.rationale: wire contract envelope { data, code, msg } in serialize order; code is a JSON string never a number, no success field, business errors stay HTTP 200

nodes.label: envelope::PageRes<T>
nodes.rationale: pagination wrapper carried as Res data: current/size/total (u64 numbers) + records ([] when empty); no pages, no success field

nodes.label: envelope::BizCode
nodes.rationale: frozen 13-variant business-code matrix; code() + default_msg() strings are wire contract facts (simplified Chinese), incl 5003 PermissionDenied / 4040 NotFound / 7777 ModalLogout / 1000 LoginFailed

nodes.label: error::AppError
nodes.rationale: non-200 error type (NotFound -> 404, Internal -> 500) mapped onto Res envelope; differs from business errors that stay 200 and signal via code

nodes.label: server main()
nodes.rationale: boot: config -> tracing -> postgres -> redis -> build_enforcer -> xdb init -> load initial_session_mode from system_settings -> AppState -> spawn policy_watcher + settings_watcher -> Prometheus layer -> Router (all /systemManage/* routes with enforce_mw route_layer + outer ctx_mw + metrics layer) -> serve

nodes.label: server main health handler
nodes.rationale: GET /health -> 'ok' (no auth, no middleware)

nodes.label: server main init_tracing
nodes.rationale: EnvFilter + fmt subscriber; 'pretty' vs json output format

nodes.label: AppState
nodes.rationale: shared state (db/redis/jwt/enforcer Arc<RwLock>/session_mode Arc<RwLock>); session_mode replaces jwt.single_session_default as the source the 028 enforcement seam reads, reloaded by settings_watcher on settings:invalidate

nodes.label: auth::bearer::bearer_token
nodes.rationale: extracts trimmed token from Authorization: Bearer <token>; case-sensitive prefix, empty -> None

nodes.label: auth::bearer::verify_bearer
nodes.rationale: composes bearer_token -> jwt::verify, returns neutral Option<Claims>; 5 callsites map None three ways: fail-closed (enforce_mw), advisory (get_user_info/get_user_routes/is_route_exist), best-effort (ctx_mw)

nodes.label: button_auth::get_role_button_codes
nodes.rationale: reads a role's button codes (lexicographic) via enforcer get_filtered_policy(0,[role,'','button']); button policy rows are (p, v0=role, v1=button_code, v2='button')

nodes.label: button_auth::buttons_for_roles_via_casbin
nodes.rationale: getUserInfo's deduped lexicographic union of multi-role button codes via casbin; replaced the hardwired auth/buttons.rs matrix

nodes.label: casbin_rule table
nodes.rationale: central RBAC policy table: ptype+v0..v5 used by stock adapter; 034 added protected/created_at/created_by governance cols invisible to the adapter; rows encode endpoint policies (v2=HTTP method), menu visibility (v2='menu'), and button perms (v2='button')

nodes.label: single_session_default settings flow
nodes.rationale: single_session_default row seeded in system_settings (028), loaded at boot into AppState.session_mode (029 T005, config fallback), runtime-swapped by settings_watcher on settings:invalidate; drives 028 single-session enforcement seam

nodes.label: policy recycle-bin (archive/restore)
nodes.rationale: 034/035 governance: revoked casbin policies move to sys_casbin_policy_archive (restore buffer); getArchivedPolicies lists, restorePolicy moves back to live (physical delete from archive). Protected rows cannot be revoked

nodes.label: ENDPOINT_REGISTRY
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth: 35 enforce_mw-protected (method,path) tuples; build-time lint asserts each path is byte-identical to a main.rs route literal under the exact-equality Casbin matcher (drift = dead route).

nodes.label: get_role_endpoints
nodes.rationale: Reads a role's HTTP-method casbin rows (v2 in GET/POST/DELETE) via get_filtered_policy per method; sorted by (path,method); ignores menu (v2='menu') and button (v2='button') rows — orthogonal dimensions.

nodes.label: enforce_mw
nodes.rationale: First Casbin enforce point: verify access JWT, single-session gate, fetch DB-fresh effective roles (not token snapshot), enforce (role,path,method). Fail-CLOSED on DB/casbin error → 403/5003. Emits casbin_enforce_total metric.

nodes.label: build_enforcer
nodes.rationale: Boots casbin Enforcer from RBAC MODEL + SeaOrmAdapter over live DB; fail-fast from main.

nodes.label: MODEL
nodes.rationale: RBAC casbin model string: r=sub,obj,act; exact-equality matcher; allow-override effect; g (role-of-role) declared but unused — role code IS the subject directly.

nodes.label: sign
nodes.rationale: Pure HS256 sign: mints fresh jti per call (makes same-second tokens byte-distinct so token_hash sha256 can't collide on UNIQUE), carries sid (per-login session lineage).

nodes.label: verify
nodes.rationale: Verify signature + exp (leeway 0, deterministic) + aud. iss intentionally NOT validated. Pre-028 tokens lacking required sid claim fail deserialize → rejected (forces one re-login after deploy).

nodes.label: Claims
nodes.rationale: JWT body: sub/user_id/roles/exp/iat/iss/aud/sid/jti. roles is NON-authoritative for authz (018 B: enforce re-fetches from DB). base-web treats tokens as opaque.

nodes.label: get_role_menu_route_names
nodes.rationale: Reads a role's visible-menu route_names from casbin rows with v2='menu' via get_filtered_policy; ignores endpoint (HTTP method) rows.

nodes.label: mutate_and_reload
nodes.rationale: Central commit-then-reload-then-publish seam for policy edits: atomic mutate_in_txn (policy+audit both-or-neither) → if result.mutated() reload enforcer + PUBLISH casbin:policy:invalidate (035 US2: skips reload/publish on structural no-op).

nodes.label: reload_and_publish
nodes.rationale: Extracted enforcer load_policy (write lock held only during load) + best-effort publish_policy_invalidate; reused by batch path (N per-menu txns → single reload at end).

nodes.label: PolicyMutated
nodes.rationale: Trait deciding if a governance write truly changed policy; impl'd for SetRoleOutcome (Applied→true incl empty-diff per FR-006), RestoreOutcome (Restored→true), bool (menu cascade).

nodes.label: spawn_policy_watcher
nodes.rationale: Boot-time fire-and-forget Redis pub-sub watcher: SUBSCRIBE casbin:policy:invalidate on a dedicated connection, reload enforcer on any message; resilient retry w/ backoff.

nodes.label: publish_policy_invalidate
nodes.rationale: PUBLISH on casbin:policy:invalidate; called from reload_and_publish so every instance's watcher reloads.

nodes.label: is_current
nodes.rationale: 028 per-request session-pointer convergence: Redis sess:{uid} hot path → sys_user persistent truth fallback; resolved=off never kicks; resolved=on requires sid==pointer. Fail-OPEN by design (additive check, not main gate).

nodes.label: resolve_policy
nodes.rationale: Pure policy resolution: 'on'→true, 'off'→false, 'inherit'/unknown→follows system_default (fail-safe).

nodes.label: set_pointer
nodes.rationale: Persist-then-cache: sys_user.current_session_id (must succeed) then best-effort Redis sess:{uid} cache (swallowed on hiccup, self-heals on next read).

nodes.label: spawn_settings_watcher
nodes.rationale: Boot-time Redis pub-sub watcher mirroring policy_watcher: SUBSCRIBE settings:invalidate, re-read single_session_default from DB and swap in-memory SessionMode; keeps current value on reload miss/error.

nodes.label: publish_settings_invalidate
nodes.rationale: PUBLISH on settings:invalidate; called from update_system_setting write path so every instance reloads session_mode.

nodes.label: login
nodes.rationale: POST /auth/login: verify creds (uniform 1000 on any failure, no enumeration), mint sid, write login-attempt audit, issue token pair, persist rotation chain-head, single-session revoke (resolved=on), always set_pointer.

nodes.label: get_user_info
nodes.rationale: GET /auth/getUserInfo: verify access JWT → single-session 7777 gate → load active user → roles fresh from DB → buttons via casbin button policy. Returns {userId(string), userName(alias), roles, buttons}; any unusable token → 3333.

nodes.label: refresh_token
nodes.rationale: POST /auth/refreshToken (OPEN): verify against REFRESH secret (fail→8888), 7777 pointer gate, pre-sign new pair, drive sys_token::rotate (Rotated/BenignConcurrent→200, Reuse/NotFound→8888, DbErr→5000). Never returns 3333/9999/9998.

nodes.label: issue_tokens
nodes.rationale: Signs access (jwt_secret/access TTL) + refresh (refresh_token_secret/refresh TTL) pair sharing user_id/roles/sid.

nodes.label: login_attempt_inner
nodes.rationale: Inner login logic returning Ok((token,user_id,session_policy))/Err(BizCode) so the outer login fn writes exactly one login-attempt audit row on every terminal path; uniform 1000 collapses user-not-found/wrong-password/disabled/role-lookup-error (no enumeration).

nodes.label: LoginToken
nodes.rationale: Login/refresh success wire DTO {token, refreshToken} (camelCase), matches base-web LoginToken typing.

nodes.label: LoginReq
nodes.rationale: Login request body {userName, password} camelCase.

nodes.label: UserInfo
nodes.rationale: getUserInfo wire DTO {userId(string), userName, roles, buttons}; matches base-web auth.d.ts.

nodes.label: get_user_routes
nodes.rationale: GET /route/getUserRoutes (JWT, no enforce mw): verify token → 7777 gate → roles ordered (per-role home) → build MenuRoute tree from sys_menu → Casbin filter_routes → {routes, home}.

nodes.label: get_constant_routes
nodes.rationale: GET /route/getConstantRoutes — PUBLIC, returns 5 constant routes the SPA needs before login.

nodes.label: is_route_exist
nodes.rationale: GET /route/isRouteExist?routeName=: JWT-verified, role-filtered visibility check via Casbin route_exists_for_roles.

nodes.label: update_role_menu
nodes.rationale: POST updateRoleMenu: HARD-REPLACE role's visible menus via set_role_dimension(Menu); protected-removal rejection (m033 governance menus) replaces old self-lock guard (fixes D13).

nodes.label: update_role_button
nodes.rationale: POST updateRoleButton: HARD-REPLACE button codes via set_role_dimension(Button); validates codes against aggregate_active_buttons registry; no self-lock.

nodes.label: update_role_endpoints
nodes.rationale: POST updateRoleEndpoints: root-mode guard rejects R_SUPER edit; validates (method,path) against ENDPOINT_REGISTRY; HARD-REPLACE via set_role_dimension(Endpoint).

nodes.label: get_all_endpoints
nodes.rationale: GET getAllEndpoints: infallible, returns sorted ENDPOINT_REGISTRY as [{method,path}].

nodes.label: get_role_endpoints
nodes.rationale: GET getRoleEndpoints: R_SUPER→full registry (root all-access), else endpoint_auth::get_role_endpoints mapped+sorted to Endpoint{method,path}.

nodes.label: get_role_menu
nodes.rationale: GET getRoleMenu: roleId→code→menu_auth::get_role_menu_route_names→sys_menu ids; returns Vec<i64> for modal checkbox tree.

nodes.label: get_role_button
nodes.rationale: GET getRoleButton: roleId→code→button_auth::get_role_button_codes (sorted).

nodes.label: delete_menu
nodes.rationale: DELETE deleteMenu: protected/child guards then delete_menu_cascade_in_txn (menu soft-delete + menu-visibility policy revoke same txn) via mutate_and_reload.

nodes.label: restore_menu
nodes.rationale: POST restoreMenu: 3 ordered guards (must be deleted / route_name not occupied / parent active) then restore_menu_cascade_in_txn brings back archived visibility policy.

nodes.label: get_archived_policies
nodes.rationale: GET getArchivedPolicies (034 US5): list_archived (excludes menu_soft_delete) → ArchivedPolicy DTO for recycle-bin UI.

nodes.label: restore_policy
nodes.rationale: POST restorePolicy: sys_casbin_rule::restore via mutate_and_reload; Restored writes Restore audit ({role,target,dimension}); NoOp→0000; NotFound→2222.

nodes.label: restore_audit_payload
nodes.rationale: Pure fn building restore audit payload_after {role,target,dimension} from v0/v1/v2 (identity carried before archive row deletion, replacing dangling archive_id).

nodes.label: batch_delete_menus
nodes.rationale: DELETE batchDeleteMenu: atomic guard pass then per-menu cascade txns; any_mutated tracking → single reload_and_publish at end (skip if all no-op).

nodes.label: update_system_setting
nodes.rationale: POST updateSystemSetting: value_in_value_type validation then system_settings::update then best-effort publish_settings_invalidate.

nodes.label: mutate_in_txn
nodes.rationale: Sole atomic write entry: binds a data-mutation closure + optional audit write into one DatabaseTransaction (both-or-neither); calls sys_operation_log::write_in_txn.

nodes.label: AuditEvent
nodes.rationale: Pure audit-event data struct (no entity:: path): operation/entity_table/entity_id/payload_before/after/operator/trace_id.

nodes.label: delete_menu_cascade_in_txn
nodes.rationale: 034 US3: soft-delete menu + revoke its menu-visibility policy across all roles same txn (fixes DRIFT-2 orphan policy / DRIFT-4 unaudited); archives revoked rows reason=menu_soft_delete.

nodes.label: restore_menu_cascade_in_txn
nodes.rationale: 034 US3: restore menu + bring back archived visibility policy filtered by deleted_at==archived_at (same-generation isolation prevents cross-generation stale revival = DRIFT-3 fix).

nodes.label: SoftDeletable
nodes.rationale: Trait: entity declares deleted_at_column, gets find_active() base query (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL).

nodes.label: connect_postgres
nodes.rationale: Open Postgres pool + SELECT 1 ping; fail-fast on boot.

nodes.label: connect_redis
nodes.rationale: Open Redis ConnectionManager (auto-reconnect, cloneable) + PING verify; fail-fast on boot.

nodes.label: insert_snapshot
nodes.rationale: Only place constructing entity::sys_casbin_policy_archive::ActiveModel (009 lint route b); revoke writes a snapshot of the revoked live casbin_rule row into the archive buffer, preserving created_at/created_by provenance.

nodes.label: find_menu_visibility_archives
nodes.rationale: Finds menu-visibility archives by exact archived_at equality for same-generation isolation: a menu soft-delete's deleted_at and its cascade archive's archived_at are byte-identical (Postgres transaction_timestamp in same txn), so reused route_names with stale older-generation archives are excluded (dead cruft never restorable).

nodes.label: list_archived
nodes.rationale: US5 getArchivedPolicies recycle-bin list; excludes archive_reason='menu_soft_delete' rows (those return via restore_menu_cascade, not the policy recycle bin per Clarification Q2).

nodes.label: REASON_MENU_SOFT_DELETE
nodes.rationale: Shared reason constant used by both the revoke-write side (menu soft delete cascade) and restore find side.

nodes.label: grant
nodes.rationale: DB-first INSERT of one live casbin_rule policy row (ptype=p, v0=role, v1=obj, v2=act); does not touch the in-memory enforcer — reload is the post-commit governance service's job.

nodes.label: revoke
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete: snapshots the live row to archive then DELETEs it; protected rows return Rejected (untouched). RevokeOutcome::Rejected maps to BizCode 2222 in the handler.

nodes.label: restore
nodes.rationale: Restores an archived snapshot back into casbin_rule with a pre-check to avoid txn-poisoning 7-col unique violation; returns Restored{v0,v1,v2} so the handler can build audit identity (035 US1) instead of a dangling archive_id.

nodes.label: set_role_dimension
nodes.rationale: 034 US4a unified HARD-REPLACE write path replacing the set_role_menu/button/endpoint triplets; DB-first diff against live casbin_rule, precise per-row revoke/grant with no wildcard (the empty-v2 cross-dimension delete footgun structurally disappears); endpoint per-method falls out naturally since each (path,method) is a distinct row.

nodes.label: diff_plan
nodes.rationale: Pure no-DB diff: compares on (v1,v2) pairs (critical for endpoints where same path different method are distinct rows); flags protected_removal so an omitted protected row triggers whole-batch rejection (zero change).

nodes.label: roles_with_menu_visibility
nodes.rationale: US3 menu-policy cascade: distinct v0 roles that can see route_name (ptype=p,v1=route_name,v2=menu); used before per-role revoke during menu soft delete.

nodes.label: Dimension
nodes.rationale: Three permission dimensions Menu/Button/Endpoint; matches_v2 maps menu->'menu', button->'button', endpoint->HTTP method GET|POST|DELETE (closed set, no PUT/PATCH).

nodes.label: login_attempt_active_model
nodes.rationale: Pure mapping seam LoginAttempt->ActiveModel; client_ip written as real INET via IpNetwork::from(IpAddr) /32 or /128 (no PG 42804); operator_id nullable BIGINT accepts NULL directly (no None->NotSet workaround needed unlike sys_operation_log operator_ip).

nodes.label: write
nodes.rationale: Best-effort connectionless INSERT of one login attempt; caller (login handler) only warns on Err and does not interrupt login response (FR-003).

nodes.label: assemble_menu_tree
nodes.rationale: Pure no-DB function turning flat active Model rows into a tree; stable sort by order_no with None last (D5 regression rule for seed manage_user-detail); orphans (parent not in active set) are skipped.

nodes.label: would_create_cycle
nodes.rationale: Pure re-parent cycle guard (025); walks parent chain up, bounded by all_menus.len() to conservatively reject corrupt cyclic data.

nodes.label: route_names_for_ids
nodes.rationale: updateRoleMenu: maps modal menu_ids to active route_names (the Casbin menu-visibility policy key); active-only, soft-deleted skipped, empty-input short-circuit.

nodes.label: ids_for_route_names
nodes.rationale: getRoleMenu: maps a role's Casbin menu-visibility policy route_names back to menu ids to preload the modal's checked tree (inverse of route_names_for_ids).

nodes.label: soft_delete_in_txn
nodes.rationale: US3 transaction-internal soft delete core, composing menu mutation + policy revoke in one caller-provided txn; returns route_name for the cascade; reload/publish deferred to caller (policy_governance) post-commit.

nodes.label: restore_in_txn
nodes.rationale: US3 transaction-internal restore core; returns (route_name, deleted_at) where deleted_at enables same-generation archive isolation against find_menu_visibility_archives.

nodes.label: create_menu
nodes.rationale: addMenu: route_name uniqueness pre-check then atomic insert + INSERT audit; DuplicateRouteName maps to biz error 2222.

nodes.label: update_menu
nodes.rationale: updateMenu: 18 business cols incl 025 re-parent parent_id, paired §I.6 updated_at/by, but route_name/menu_type stay D2 immutable; None->Ok(false) no-op.

nodes.label: MenuNode
nodes.rationale: Intermediate tree struct (plain facade struct, NOT entity::) shared by US1 MenuRoute and US2 MenuTree mappings; mapped to wire DTO by route::menu::menu_node_to_route.

nodes.label: audit_active_model
nodes.rationale: Pure AuditEvent->ActiveModel mapping; operator_ip None->NotSet (skip column) to avoid INET cast PG 42804 — Some(ip) text binding would still trigger 42804, this feature always writes None.

nodes.label: write_in_txn
nodes.rationale: Only place constructing entity::sys_operation_log::ActiveModel; inserts one audit row inside a caller-managed transaction (lifecycle/rollback owned by caller).

nodes.label: create_role
nodes.rationale: addRole: code uniqueness pre-check (partial unique sys_role_code_active_uniq) then atomic insert + INSERT audit; DuplicateCode maps to biz 2222.

nodes.label: update_role
nodes.rationale: updateRole: name/role_desc/status + paired §I.6 updated_at/by; code stays D2 immutable; None->Ok(false) no-op mirrors sys_user::update_user.

nodes.label: update_role_home
nodes.rationale: US2 set per-role landing page (home) only + paired §I.6 stamps; FR-007 home change captured in audit before/after.

nodes.label: soft_delete
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete role with atomic SOFT_DELETE audit; seed-role protection enforced at handler (code-based guard), not in facade.

nodes.label: find_active_enabled
nodes.rationale: Effective role set query (deleted_at IS NULL AND status=1); roles_for_user(s)/assignment resolution/getAllRoles consume this so disabled/soft-deleted roles auto-fail authorization and are unassignable.

nodes.label: list_active_all
nodes.rationale: getAllRoles (016 US3 assignment dropdown) only effective roles, id DESC; deliberately split from getRoleList which shows disabled (R1/FR-012).

nodes.label: create_user
nodes.rationale: addUser: user_name uniqueness pre-check, default password 123456 argon2 hash (D2), role replace-all in same txn, INSERT audit with redacted password; DuplicateUserName maps to biz 2222.

nodes.label: update_user
nodes.rationale: updateUser: business cols + paired §I.6 stamps + role replace-all in same txn; user_name/password not in SET (Q1=A immutable); None->Ok(false) no-op.

nodes.label: soft_delete
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete user with atomic SOFT_DELETE audit (password redacted in payload_before); None->Ok(false) no-op exercised by sys_operation_log live tests.

nodes.label: set_current_session
nodes.rationale: 028 only write channel for current_session_id (auth/session.rs cannot touch entity:: per 009 lint); a machine-managed system column, so no §I.6 stamps, no operator, no audit.

nodes.label: update_session_policy
nodes.rationale: 029 updates per-account session_policy only with atomic UPDATE audit; deliberately omits §I.6 updated_at/by stamps because the audit row itself is the system-of-record for this policy-config column; does not touch 028 current_session_id.

nodes.label: find_active_by_name
nodes.rationale: Login lookup of single active user by user_name; returns Ok(None) when not found.

nodes.label: replace_roles_in_txn
nodes.rationale: R4 replace-all of a user's role assignments inside the caller's txn; resolves codes via find_active_enabled (unknown/disabled/soft-deleted silently skipped, US2-2), deletes old, insert_many new with empty-set guard (sea-orm errors on empty insert_many).

nodes.label: roles_for_user
nodes.rationale: login/getUserInfo: a user's effective role CODE list; two-step query, disabled/soft-deleted roles excluded via sys_role::find_active_enabled, empty fast-path.

nodes.label: roles_for_user_ordered
nodes.rationale: getUserRoutes: a user's effective (id,code) ordered by sys_role.id ASC to deterministically pick the first-active-role's home as the per-role landing page.

nodes.label: roles_for_users
nodes.rationale: getUserList batch role lookup (016 SC-006 fixed 2 queries avoiding N+1); assembles user_id->Vec<code> in memory.

nodes.label: update
nodes.rationale: Only write channel for system_settings (009 lint); updates setting_value + paired §I.6 stamps + UPDATE audit; entity_id None since PK is String; None->Ok(false) no-op.

nodes.label: get
nodes.rationale: Read one non-deleted setting by setting_key; used by boot-load and the single_session_default flow.

nodes.label: parse_session_default
nodes.rationale: Read-side typed accessor: exact lowercase 'on'->On else Off (fail-safe, never panics); converts stored string to config::SessionMode.

nodes.label: menu_node_to_route
nodes.rationale: Maps an assembled sys_menu MenuNode into the wire MenuRoute DTO recursively; props Some(true) only on ':'-param paths; reproduces base-web elegant-router '$' composite component format; must byte-match the 014 business_routes baseline (D5).

nodes.label: filter_routes
nodes.rationale: Tree-prunes a route tree by Casbin enforce((role,name,'menu')); a parent like manage is kept only if >=1 child is visible; fail-closed on enforce errors matching auth/enforce.rs middleware.

nodes.label: MenuRoute
nodes.rationale: Wire DTO mirroring base-web ElegantConstRoute/menu route; serde camelCase so JSON matches base-web typings (i18nKey/hideInMenu/keepAlive/activeMenu); meta.roles intentionally omitted (dynamic mode — server filters).

nodes.label: constant_routes
nodes.rationale: The 5 public constant routes (getConstantRoutes, NOT role-filtered): 403/404/500/login/iframe-page, each meta.constant=true + hideInMenu=true.

nodes.label: business_routes
nodes.rationale: 014 verbatim in-code business route tree [home, manage{...}] retained only as the regression baseline; runtime getUserRoutes now reads the tree from sys_menu.

nodes.label: route_exists_for_roles
nodes.rationale: isRouteExist: whether a route name is enforce-visible to the user's roles via direct Casbin check.

nodes.label: search_by_ip
nodes.rationale: ip2region xdb lookup: converts IP to u32, binary-searches the vector+segment index in a memory-mapped cache, returns a '|'-segmented region string; uses unsafe pointer reads for performance.

nodes.label: searcher_init
nodes.rationale: Sets XDB_FILEPATH env and warms both full-data and vector-index OnceCell caches; rev2 layout looks for resources/ip2region.xdb then falls back to rev1 ../server/resources path.

nodes.label: get_full_cache
nodes.rationale: Lazily loads the entire xdb file into a OnceCell Vec<u8> (loaded once across threads).

nodes.label: get_block_by_size
nodes.rationale: Unsafe little-endian fixed-width integer read at an offset within the xdb byte cache (2/4-byte fast paths).

nodes.label: ToUIntIP
nodes.rationale: Trait converting u32 / &str / Ipv4Addr into a u32 IP; the &str impl tries numeric parse first then dotted-quad — search_by_ip is generic over this trait.

nodes.label: dynamic-route wire camelCase contract
nodes.rationale: Cross-component invariant: rust MenuRoute/RouteMeta serde camelCase + skip_serializing_if=Option::is_none must match base-web typings exactly and reproduce elegant-router's '$' composite component format grepped from base-web/src/router/elegant/routes.ts, else base-web cannot build the route and the menu won't render.

nodes.label: menu-visibility Casbin policy key
nodes.rationale: Cross-cutting invariant: a menu's route_name is the v1 key of a (ptype=p, v0=role, v1=route_name, v2='menu') Casbin policy row. updateRoleMenu writes route_names (sys_menu.route_names_for_ids), getRoleMenu reads them back (ids_for_route_names), getUserRoutes filters by enforce((role,route_name,'menu')), and menu soft-delete cascades archive/restore of these same rows.
